info.title: Who It's For
info.text: Offices, birthdays, weddings, wakes, engagement parties and any gathering that deserves proper food.

info.title: Where We Deliver
info.text: Across London, with collection also available from Peckham Palms.

info.title: Lead Time
info.text: We ask for at least 5 days' notice for platters and 14 days for large events of 50+ guests.

info.title: Minimum Order
info.text: Platters serve 8–10 people, with a minimum order of 2 platters per booking.

items.name: Naija Bites Board
items.description: Chicken gizzard, sticky wings, cassava chips and fried plantain, served on a sharing board.

items.name: Hot Wings Platter
items.description: A generous tray of our lightly battered hot wings with dipping sauces on the side.

items.name: Jollof & Chicken Sharing Tray
items.description: Smoky jollof rice, forbidden sauce chicken and fried plantain, ready to serve straight from the tray.

items.name: Suya & Rice Feast
items.description: A mix of chicken and beef suya with basmati or jollof rice, spinach stew and plantain.

items.name: Chin Chin Pie Bites
items.description: Bite-sized portions of our chin chin, banana and caramel pie, topped with Milo.

items.name: Plantain Ice Cream Tubs
items.description: Individual tubs of our homemade vanilla plantain ice cream.

note: Prices are a guide and vary by guest count and menu selection. Get in touch below for a full quote tailored to your event.
